summary_ja: 2026年7月に量産開始したSamsung PM1763のPCIe 6、性能、capacity、endurance、security仕様と、concept段階のzNAND-Oを追加しました。PM1763のvendor最大値をHPCI実効性能にせず、U.2はPCIe 5である点を分離し、KIOXIA GP1等との共通条件比較を残します。単一モデルによる暫定調査で、Consensusは未完了です。
summary_en: This update adds PCIe 6, performance, capacity, endurance, and security specifications for Samsung PM1763, which entered mass production in July 2026, alongside the concept-stage zNAND-O. PM1763 vendor maxima are not treated as HPCI effective performance; U.2 is separated as PCIe 5, and common-condition comparison with KIOXIA GP1 and alternatives remains required. This is provisional single-model research with Consensus incomplete.

items.name_ja: Samsung PM1763 PCIe 6 SSDの量産開始
items.name_en: Samsung PM1763 PCIe 6 SSD enters mass production
items.statement_ja: Samsungは9世代V-NANDと4 nm controllerを使うPM1763の量産開始を公表しました。PCIe 6.0 x4、NVMe 2.1、OCP 2.6を基盤とし、sequential read/writeは最大28,400/21,000 MB/s、random read/writeは最大6.8M/0.95M IOPS、容量は3.84～61.44 TB、enduranceは1 DWPD・5年です。E1.S、E3.S、U.2を掲げますが、U.2はPCIe 5のみです。最大値はvendor内部評価であり、HPCIの混在I/O、tail latency、sustained write、RAID・filesystem性能ではありません。
items.statement_en: Samsung announced volume production of PM1763 using ninth-generation V-NAND and a 4 nm controller. It uses PCIe 6.0 x4, NVMe 2.1, and OCP 2.6, with maximum sequential read/write of 28,400/21,000 MB/s, random read/write of 6.8M/0.95M IOPS, capacities from 3.84 to 61.44 TB, and one DWPD for five years. E1.S, E3.S, and U.2 are listed, but U.2 is PCIe 5 only. These maxima are vendor internal evaluations, not HPCI mixed-I/O, tail-latency, sustained-write, RAID, or filesystem results.
items.hpci_relevance_ja: PCIe 6 storage tierの調達候補として、KIOXIA GP1の高耐久・高random-read sampleとは、量産性、capacity、DWPD、sequential、softwareを同じ軸で比較できます。
items.hpci_relevance_en: As a PCIe 6 storage-tier candidate, it can be compared with the high-endurance, high-random-read KIOXIA GP1 sample using common axes for availability, capacity, DWPD, sequential performance, and software.
adoption_conditions_ja: 同容量・form factor・coolingでsequential、random、mixed、tail latency、sustained write、energyを測る。
GP1等とcapacity、DWPD、failure、firmware update、供給・価格を比較する。
PCIe 6 host、switch、cable、hot-plug、telemetry、error recoveryの相互運用を検証する。
adoption_conditions_en: Measure sequential, random, mixed, tail latency, sustained writes, and energy at equal capacity, form factor, and cooling.
Compare capacity, DWPD, failures, firmware updates, supply, and price with GP1 and alternatives.
Validate interoperability across PCIe 6 hosts, switches, cabling, hot-plug, telemetry, and error recovery.

items.statement_ja: PM1763はPQC、SPDM 1.4、CNSA 2.0、TDISPに基づくlink encryptionを掲げます。これは対応機能の表明であり、全algorithm・modeの有効化、hostとのattestation chain、key lifecycle、性能影響、certificate更新、HPCIでの認証を示しません。storage encryption at restとPCIe link・virtual device isolationを別々に受入評価する必要があります。
items.statement_en: PM1763 lists PQC, SPDM 1.4, CNSA 2.0, and TDISP-based link encryption. This states feature support but does not establish enabled algorithms and modes, host attestation chains, key lifecycles, performance effects, certificate renewal, or HPCI qualification. Storage encryption at rest and PCIe-link and virtual-device isolation need separate acceptance tests.
items.hpci_relevance_ja: confidential computing nodeへ高速SSDを組み込む際、CPU・acceleratorだけでなくstorage device identityとdata-in-motionもtrust boundaryへ含められます。
items.hpci_relevance_en: When integrating high-speed SSDs into confidential-computing nodes, storage-device identity and data in motion can be included in the trust boundary alongside CPUs and accelerators.
adoption_conditions_ja: host root of trustからSSDまでのSPDM/TDISP attestationと失敗時隔離を試験する。
firmware署名、rollback、certificate・key更新、secure eraseを運用手順に含める。
暗号有無でthroughput、tail latency、CPU負荷、energyを比較する。
adoption_conditions_en: Test SPDM/TDISP attestation from host root of trust to SSD and isolation after failure.
Include firmware signing, rollback, certificate and key renewal, and secure erase in operations.
Compare throughput, tail latency, CPU overhead, and energy with and without protection.

items.name_en: Four- and eight-layer zNAND-O concept models
items.statement_ja: SamsungはV-NANDを基盤とするzNAND-Oを4層・8層構成として示し、space efficiency、I/O、latencyをedge AI向けに改善する構想としています。capacity、cell type、interface、controller、read/write latency、endurance、energy、yield、sample・製品時期は公表されていません。名称からOptane相当のstorage-class memoryや製品と推定せず、技術層と用途が確定するまでconceptとして扱います。
items.statement_en: Samsung presents zNAND-O as four- and eight-layer configurations based on V-NAND, targeting improved space efficiency, I/O, and latency for edge AI. Capacity, cell type, interface, controller, read/write latency, endurance, energy, yield, and sampling or product dates are not published. Its name is not used to infer an Optane-like storage-class memory or a product; it remains a concept until its technical layer and use case are established.
items.hpci_relevance_ja: 将来のmemory-storage gap候補は、名称でなくload/store可否、block/byte access、persistence、latency、endurance、software modelで分類します。
items.hpci_relevance_en: Future memory-storage-gap candidates should be classified by load/store access, block versus byte access, persistence, latency, endurance, and software model rather than naming.
adoption_conditions_ja: sample、量産、価格、供給、data retentionを一次情報で追跡する。
adoption_conditions_en: Verify interface, access granularity, persistence, latency, endurance, capacity, and software model.
Compare with PM1763, XL-FLASH, DRAM, and SCM candidates under the same workloads.
Track samples, production, price, supply, and data retention through primary sources.
